name: Alchemy Jug
text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Jug that produces a chosen liquid such as water, wine, oil or acid, a limited amount per day.

name: Bag of Holding
text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Bag with a much larger extradimensional interior (about 500 lb / 64 cubic feet) that stays light.

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Cap that lets you breathe underwater while worn.

name: Goggles of Night
text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Goggles granting Darkvision to 60 feet (or extending existing Darkvision).

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: Yes. Ammunition weapon that grants +1 to attack and damage and produces its own ammunition.

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Thrown weapon with +1 to attack and damage that flies back to your hand after being thrown.

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Pair of stones that let two holders send short messages to each other once per day.

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Wand that casts Detect Magic with charges that regenerate daily.

text: Magic item plan (Replicate Magic Item). Attunement: No. Wand that reveals nearby secret doors and traps, with limited daily charges.

name: Armor +1
